frame: x 0 = the vertical expectations axis, x 100 = the tip of the time-axis arrow, as in the digitized positions (data/raw/gartner-hype-cycle/INDEX.md). Boundaries are, in order: innovation_trigger|peak, peak|trough, trough|slope, slope|plateau.
method: Pixel measurement of the vertical phase lines on each edition's chart image. The chart images are Gartner's copyright and are not in this repository; only the measured numbers are.

editions.note: The 2005 chart (a draft dated 27 July 2005) draws no phase boundaries and no phase labels. Boundaries are the mean of the 12 measured editions 2006 to 2017, whose boundaries vary by at most 0.66 points in this frame. Treat 2005 phases near a boundary as uncertain.

Measured on a 1066 x 600 px copy of the published chart. Frame: left axis at x=218 px is 0, tip of the time-axis arrow at x=945 px is 100 (the frame of the digitized positions). Each boundary is the centre column of the drawn vertical phase line, read where it runs above the phase-label bar. Precision about 0.2 points.
